overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Tag presents a concise status or category label as static text.
whenToUseItems: Use a Tag to communicate a short status or category.
Choose the type that best matches the label's meaning.
whenToAvoidItems: Do not use a Tag as a button or other interactive control.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate a status.

variants.title: Variants
variants.text: Choose the appearance that fits the surface and the emphasis needed.
rows: Highlight|Highlight|Emphasized label with a stronger type treatment.
Translucent|Translucent|Token color background at 24% opacity for colored surfaces.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.text: A Tag contains a label and may include an icon.
rows: Tag root|Required|Contains the label and optional icon.
Icon|Optional|Supports the label; do not use it as the only status cue.
Text|Required|Provides the meaning of the Tag.

writing.title: Labels and icons
writing.text: Keep Tag content brief and clear.
items: Use a short label that remains understandable without its icon.
Use a custom icon only when it supports the label.
Avoid sentences or multiple lines of text.

behavior.title: Appearance behavior
behavior.text: Translucent appearance keeps the medium size and requires an icon.
rows: Translucent|Medium only|Required|Colored surfaces; not white backgrounds.

related.title: Related documentation
related.text: The component overview includes live examples, API controls, platform snippets, and design tokens.

colors.title: Color tokens
colors.text: Translucent colors use the following token colors as backgrounds at 24% opacity. Text and icon colors use the corresponding solid tokens.
colors.opacity: The default and highlight appearances use their standard Tag color tokens.

typography.title: Typography
typography.text: Tag uses the component's existing typography tokens. The translucent appearance preserves the same typography as a medium Tag with an icon.

sizes.title: Size and shape
sizes.text: Translucent is available only in medium size with an icon; all other appearances keep their existing sizes.
rows: Small|Compact Tag with the existing small size metrics.
Medium|Standard Tag size; translucent uses the same geometry.

structure.title: Structure
structure.text: The root contains optional icon content and a text element.

requirements.title: Requirements
items: Write a label that communicates its meaning without color or icon alone.
Keep the label concise and meaningful when read by assistive technology.

considerations.title: Implementation considerations
items: Keep a Tag non-interactive; use a control component for actions.
If a custom icon conveys unique information, include that information in the label.
